# MirrorUE

> MirrorUE is a native macOS application that streams an iPhone display at up to 120 FPS via USB CoreMediaIO and provides full mouse, trackpad, and physical keyboard control using CoreDevice UniversalHID. Free and open source under the MIT license.

## Documentation & Knowledge Base

- [How to Mirror an iPhone to Mac (2026 Guide)](https://mirrorue.xyz/mirror-iphone-to-mac/): Comprehensive guide comparing mirroring methods with keyboard and mouse control.
- [macOS Tahoe 26 & iOS 26 Mirroring Guide](https://mirrorue.xyz/iphone-mirroring-macos-tahoe-ios-26/): How to mirror iPhone 17 and iOS 26 on macOS Tahoe in Europe.
- [EU Region iPhone Mirroring Guide (EN)](https://mirrorue.xyz/iphone-mirroring-eu/): Local USB alternative to Apple iPhone Mirroring for European Union users.
- [Guide Recopie de l'iPhone sur Mac (FR)](https://mirrorue.xyz/fr/recopie-iphone-mac/): Guide en français pour afficher et contrôler son iPhone en Europe.
- [iPhone Mirroring Deutschland & EU Guide (DE)](https://mirrorue.xyz/de/iphone-mirroring-eu/): Anleitung auf Deutsch für iPhone-Mirroring in der EU.
- [Real-Device iPhone QA Automation](https://mirrorue.xyz/iphone-qa-automation/): How to automate and replay test journeys on physical iPhones using MirrorUE.

- [120 FPS ProMotion Pipeline](https://mirrorue.xyz/120fps-iphone-mirroring/): CoreMediaIO and zero-copy Metal texture architecture.
- [Hardware & OS Compatibility Matrix](https://mirrorue.xyz/compatibility/): Supported iPhones (11–17 Pro, iPhone Air), iPads, macOS 14–26, and cable specifications.

- [Performance Benchmarks & Datasets](https://mirrorue.xyz/benchmarks/): Latency, frame-rate stability telemetry, raw JSON and CSV datasets.
- [MirrorUE vs Apple iPhone Mirroring](https://mirrorue.xyz/mirrorue-vs-apple-iphone-mirroring/): Objective architectural and feature comparison.
- [MirrorUE vs QuickTime](https://mirrorue.xyz/mirrorue-vs-quicktime/): Comparison of latency, framerate, and bidirectional control.
